reviewFocus: Use as supporting presidential background for the world economy, macroeconomic coordination, trade, debt, Soviet assistance, and country positions. Prefer the briefing book for presidential guidance and this volume for necessary context.
reviewKeyExtent: The three-page master inventory identifies 25 one-page government reports totaling 25 pages; their subjects are not disclosed, so they cannot be promoted beyond this locator.

title: London [Economic] Summit: President's Background Book - July 1991 [2 of 2]
reviewTopics: London Economic Summit; President's background book; European Community; Germany; Japan
reviewFocus: This companion background volume is principally useful for country-position and cross-volume checks. Avoid duplicating country papers already represented by bilateral presidential conversations or regional files.
reviewKeyExtent: Nine withdrawals total 16 pages, including country papers on the European Community, Germany, France, Japan, and the United Kingdom.
